reason: The game requires NesysService for certificate validation via Windows certificate store. NesysService performs outbound TLS to proxy.nesys.jp and cert3.nesys.jp using client certificates. This is a production trust dependency that cannot be replaced without bypassing certificate validation.
architecture_option: OPTION D: Original protected trust dependency prevents implementation
minimum_local_surface: None - certificate trust boundary prevents any safe local adapter
safe_behaviors: Local port 1042 TCP listener (if protocol is independently understood)
blocking_factor: Certificate validation in MY\.Default store with 'nesys' subject is required. NesysService bridges to external vendor infrastructure.
